name: Day of Week Sales Pattern
description: Reveals weekly seasonality to optimise staffing, promotions, and delivery capacity by day of week.
sql:
SELECT
    DayName                              AS "Day",
    COUNT(*)                             AS "Orders",
    ROUND(SUM("Price (INR)"), 2)         AS "Revenue (INR)",
    ROUND(AVG("Price (INR)"), 2)         AS "Avg Order Value (INR)"
FROM orders
GROUP BY DayName, DayOfWeek
ORDER BY DayOfWeek;
